note: Quotes were curated by hand, then checked against an independent source. verified:true means the line matched word-for-word on the Ted Lasso fan wiki. verified:false means that check did not confirm it, NOT that the line is wrong: the wiki is mostly plot summary, so it quotes very little dialogue. Treat unverified lines as remembered-but-unconfirmed, and correct any that read wrong.

quotes.quote: Be curious, not judgmental.
I believe in hope. I believe in belief.
Taking on a challenge is a lot like riding a horse. If you're comfortable while you're doing it, you're probably doing it wrong.
You know what the happiest animal on Earth is? It's a goldfish. You know why? Got a ten-second memory. Be a goldfish.
For me, success is not about the wins and losses. It's about helping these young fellas be the best versions of themselves on and off the field.
If the Lord wanted games to end in a tie, she wouldn't have invented numbers.
There's two buttons I never like to hit: panic and snooze.
Doing the right thing is never the wrong thing.
I feel like we fell out of the lucky tree and hit every branch on the way down, ended up in a pool of cash and Sour Patch Kids.
I promise you there is something worse out there than being sad, and that's being alone and being sad.
You beating yourself up is like Woody Allen playing the clarinet. I don't want to hear it.
It's funny to think about the things in your life that can make you cry just knowing that they existed, can then become the same things that make you cry knowing that they're now gone.
I love meeting people's moms. It's like reading an instruction manual as to why they're nuts.
I hope that either all of us or none of us are judged by the actions of our weakest moments, but rather by the strength we show when and if we're ever given a second chance.
I do love a locker room. It smells like potential.
Old people are so wise. They're like tall Yodas.
The harder you work, the luckier you get.
I think things come into our lives to help us get from one place to a better place.
I think you might be so sure that you're one in a million that sometimes you forget that out there, you're just one of eleven.
All people are different people.
Fairy tales do not start, nor do they end, in the dark forest. That son of a gun always shows up smack-dab in the middle of a story.
The truth will set you free, but first it'll piss you off.
I think it's the lack of hope that comes and gets you.
I always figured tea was gonna taste like hot brown water. And you know what? I was right.
I'm not sure what y'all's smallest unit of measurement is here, but that's about how much I care.
You know the difference between a hippo and a Zippo? One's really heavy, and the other's a little lighter.
If you care about someone, and you got a little love in your heart, there ain't nothing you can't get through together.
I believe in Communism. Rom-communism, that is.
Our goal is to go out like Willie Nelson: on a high.
There's a bunch of crazy stuff on Twitter.
Barbecue sauce.
Onward. Forward.
I shouldn't bring an umbrella to a brainstorm.
Believe.
Y'all, the harder thing to do is to be kind to yourself, so let's start there.
It's not about the wins. Never has been. It's about the folks you get to do it with.
It's the hope that kills you.
Don't you dare settle for fine.
You deserve someone who makes you feel like you've been struck by fucking lightning.
No. Fuck off.
He's here, he's there, he's every-fucking-where.
Grow up.
Whistle!
I'm not a fucking role model. I'm a footballer.
You are not a fucking prick. You're just a boy who wants to be loved by the people who should love him.
If you're lucky enough to be somebody's exception, don't be a prick about it.
Don't you fucking cry.
I'm sorry I taught you the word wanker, Phoebe.
I don't want to be a fucking mascot. I want to matter.
It's the hope that kills you.
I want him to feel the way I felt. I want him to experience the same heartbreak he put me through.
Thank you, Ted. For everything.
I sabotaged you because I wanted to hurt Rupert. And I am so, so sorry.
I am done being afraid of him.
I don't want to be the woman who let a man decide who she is.
Everyone here at Richmond deserves better, and I intend to give it to them.
Oh, fuck it.
I'm famous for being almost famous.
You are a boss-ass bitch.
Love you, boss.
You're a goddess, you're a Wonder Woman, and you deserve everything.
It's okay to not be okay, but it's not okay to be a dick about it.
I don't want to be somebody's arm candy anymore. I want to be the one holding the arm.
Sometimes the kindest thing you can do is tell someone the truth.
Every disadvantage has its advantage.
Nothing is impossible. It's just not been done yet.
Ted, the man doesn't know the difference between a corner kick and a free kick, and he's still the best coach I've ever known.
Onward. Forward.
You either believe or you don't. There's no halfway.
I'm me. Why would I want to be anything else?
Jamie Tartt, do-do-do-do-do-do.
I'm not a bad person. I'm just... I've had bad people around me.
I want to be the best teammate I can be. That's it.
Coach, I've been working on my passing. Turns out it's fun.
A good mentor hopes you will move on. A great mentor knows you will.
I'm not a snitch. I'm a man with a conscience, which is worse.
Human beings are never going to be perfect. The best we can do is to keep asking for help and accepting it when you can.
I have five sons. I know exactly how loud a room of men can be.
I am not just a footballer. I am a whole person.
I want my father to be proud of the man I am, not just the player.
This is my home now. And you fight for your home.
Ola's. It's my restaurant. Named after my mother.
Football is life!
Football is death.
Football is... football.
I love football so much, it makes me want to cry and dance at the same time.
I'm the Wonder Kid. That's what they call me.
You made me feel like I was the most important person in the world, and then you abandoned me.
I know I don't deserve it, but I'd like to come back. If you'll have me.
You're here to be the best version of yourself. So be it.
The truth will set you free, but first it will piss you off.
Avoiding a problem is not the same as solving it.
You deserve to be happy, Ted. Not just useful.
Nothing works without trust, and trust takes time.
Trent Crimm, The Independent.
I came here to write about a joke and found a man worth taking seriously.
It's not a story about football. It's a story about people.
